key_insight: A particle-based Lagrangian visualization can expose coherent heat-transport routes and finite-time attracting/repelling structures that are hidden in standard Eulerian temperature fields.
engineering_relevance: This gives engineers a clearer way to diagnose and optimize unsteady convective heat transfer by revealing where thermal energy actually travels.
method: Advect massless particles through a time-reparameterized spacetime formulation of thermal transport.
Accumulate particle path contributions to build a visualization of heat-transport routes.
Identify finite-time attracting and repelling structures from the resulting trajectories.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a new visualization technique conceptually validated against the limitation that conventional Eulerian temperature views cannot reveal transport mechanisms in aperiodic heat flow.
watch_item: Because heat transport is aperiodic and non-conservative, the method may be sensitive to time reparameterization and implementation choices in unsteady data.
paper_title: Visualizing Lagrangian Heat Transport Paths and Density Structures in Unsteady Heat Transfer
